75348: Clear [Special Portal 3](#loc=75281) in Prankster's Paradise as Riku.
75364:
**Weaknesses:** Water, Poison

Char Clawbster makes full use of the big arena inside Monstro, often sending projectiles across the entire fighting area. He'll also jump up to cling to the walls and ceilings, keeping out of range. 

However, Char Clawbster has very few melee attacks. If you can get close, there isn't much it can do to defend against Riku's attacks, except run away. If Char Clawbster is hanging from he walls and ceiling, you can bring him down by attack the uvula-looking node on the other side of the map. This will flip the room, bringing Char Clawbster back into range for Riku.
